flashcards.front: Give the formal definition of Θ(g(n)).
flashcards.back: There exist positive constants c1,c2,n0 s.t. for all n≥n0: c1·g(n) ≤ f(n) ≤ c2·g(n).

flashcards.front: Which grows faster: n log n or n^1.1?
flashcards.back: n^1.1 grows faster asymptotically.
f(n)=o(g(n)) iff lim_{n→∞} f(n)/g(n) = 0.

flashcards.front: When do you add vs multiply costs in step counting?
flashcards.back: Add for sequential blocks; multiply for nested loops.

flashcards.front: Worst vs average case for linear search?
flashcards.back: Worst O(n), average O(n) under uniform random target position.
